fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Placeholder Text
fields.description: Ghost text shown inside the search input when it is empty.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Query Parameter Name
fields.description: The QueryBuilder predicate name / URL parameter. Rarely changed (default: fulltext).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the filter options.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Property Path
fields.description: The JCR metadata property to filter on (e.g. jcr:content/metadata/dc:format).

fields.name: and
fields.label: AND Logic
fields.description: When checked, all selected values must match (AND). Default is OR.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Options
fields.description: One option per line in the format: Display Label: property-value  (e.g.  JPEG: image/jpeg)

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed — use only when placing multiple search-property blocks on the same page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the filter options.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Paths
fields.description: One path per line in the format: Display Label: /content/dam/path  (e.g.  Marketing: /content/dam/marketing)

fields.name: exact
fields.label: Exact Path Match
fields.description: When checked, only assets at exactly this path match (not descendants).

fields.name: flat
fields.label: Flat (non-recursive)
fields.description: When checked, only direct children of the path are searched.

fields.name: self
fields.label: Include Self
fields.description: When checked, the path node itself is included in results.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the date inputs.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Date Property
fields.description: The JCR date property to filter on. Common values: jcr:content/metadata/dam:assetLastModified (modified date), jcr:content/metadata/jcr:created (created date).

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed — only set when placing multiple date-range blocks on the same page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Heading displayed above the tag filter options.

fields.name: property
fields.label: JCR Tag Property
fields.description: The JCR property that stores tag values (default: jcr:content/metadata/cq:tags).

fields.name: and
fields.label: AND Logic
fields.description: When checked, assets must have ALL selected tags (AND). Default is OR.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: One tag per line in the format: Display Label: namespace:tag/path  (e.g.  Approved: dam:status/approved)

fields.name: name
fields.label: Predicate Name
fields.description: QueryBuilder predicate name. Rarely changed.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Hidden Fields
fields.description: Each row in this block is a hidden search parameter. Add rows in the document using the format: predicate-name | value  (e.g. type | dam:Asset). These are passed directly to QueryBuilder or the active search provider.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Results Per Page
fields.description: Number of results to load per page / infinite-scroll batch.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Display Label
fields.description: The label shown next to the property value (e.g. File Type, Author).

fields.name: property
fields.label: Property
fields.description: The property to display. Use a JCR path (e.g. jcr:content/metadata/dc:creator) or a built-in handler name (file-type, file-size, dimensions, file-extension).

fields.name: default
fields.label: Fallback Value
fields.description: Value shown when the property is empty or missing.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Section Label
fields.description: Heading shown above the rendition list.

fields.name: actions
fields.label: Actions
fields.description: Space-separated list of actions to display. Supported values: add-to-cart, download, share. Order controls button order.
